notes: Models: F-22 glb meshes after the loader steps (matrix = mesh.matrix, float32 positions/normals, Uint16 indices, material = glTF material name); procedural ones are BoxGeometry(args).toNonIndexed() [.translate()] at `position`, with hashes of the TS geometry. Scenarios run at 1/60 s with Math.random = mulberry32(seed) (three generateUUID on a separate stream); `draws` counts wreck draws. Worlds: slope h = 3 + 0.02x - 0.015z + 1.5 sin(0.013x) cos(0.011z); flat 0; seabed -30 with water everywhere (surface 0); deck: 18 inside |x|<15, |z-deckZ|<140 else -25 (sea, surface 0), deckZ moves -12 m/s (advanced before each update), moving surface contains = on deck and 15<y<24; coast: water x>60 (surface 0, ground -20), else 0.5 + 0.01z. Each frame: actions, deck move, update(1/60), scan. Fragment ids: next number to each piece first seen when the list is scanned in order (after every action and update, and inside onBreakup). perFrame = [count, asleep, wet, draws, FNV-1a over the float64 bytes of every piece pos3 quat4 vel3 spin3 in list order]. Sample piece row: [id, pos3, quat4, asleep, visible, submerged]. Events: breakup/damage as objects; the others as [frame, type, numbers...] for the first 40 events, later as [frame, type, FNV-1a over the float64 bytes of the numbers]. Fire row: [kind, fragId, local3, live, world3?]. Mesh hashes: FNV-1a over the float32 attribute bytes.
